about_the_game:
In Caelum, the truth is already dead.

A volatile squad of social opposites are forced to unite. They aren't traditional heroes; they're a powder keg waiting to blow. Yet this fractured team is the only thing standing between the world and total collapse.

As they settle conflicts across the world, the mission starts to rot from the inside. History doesn't add up. This isn't just a war for peace anymore-- it’s a desperate claw for reality. Step into the crossfire between gospel and deception, and unravel the mysteries that lie within Caelum.

Features:

  • Full controller support via Xinput

  • Enjoy a turn-based input combo battle system that can bring forth critical attacks or guard on demand based on input timing.

  • Utilize each character's unique kit and grow with them as they unlock more of their skills.

  • Measure your own combat prowess with hi-octane combat and challenging bosses that take note of combat roles.

  • Discover equipment and other items that can either change playstyles or reinforce roles.

  • Experience the story along with side quests and minigames that correspond with the premise of the world.

  • Explore secrets and lore waiting for the brave and adventurous to uncover.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: 2.4 GHz processing speed or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 550 or higher/similar
  • DirectX: Version 9.0
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Some content may require internet connection
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: 3.0 GHz processing speed or better
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 950 or higher/similar
  • DirectX: Version 9.0
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Some content may require internet connection

short_description: Bound by secrets and divided by class, a group of unlikely allies are swept into a global conspiracy. As they peel back the layers of history, they discover a reality that defies explanation: A Truth that challenges the very fabric of their existence.
